cause: The receipt validator checked commit state, claim identity, revision, and projection operation but did not bind every projected authority field back to the committed claim and canonical claim path.
prevention: Validate the canonical response path and claim reference, exact task-unit-taskset identity, operation-specific overlay policy, primary pointer, current agent, and committed revision before acknowledging success; retain regressions for conflicting merge projections and invented overlay pointers.
summary: A zero-exit claim-progress receipt could pair the correct claim revision with a projection that selected conflicting task, unit, task-set, claim-reference, current-agent, or primary-pointer authority.
title: Bind claim-progress projection to committed claim authority
